sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: qwen3.8-27b - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen family, designed for vision, efficient general-purpose text generation and agentic workloads.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: We are officially releasing Qwen 3.8-Max, the most capable model in the Qwen family to date. This also marks the first time we will open-source the weights of a Qwen-Max-class model. Built upon the architectural foundation of Qwen 3.5, Qwen 3.8-Max scales to 2.4 trillion parameters, delivering comprehensive improvements across coding, work, research, and long-horizon tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B (2026): The Complete Guide to Qwen's New 27B Vision ...
sources.snippet: The complete 2026 guide to Qwen3.8-27B — Qwen's new 27B dense vision-language model with DeepSWE 42.2, Terminal Bench 73.0, OSWorld 84.3, native image/video input, 262K context, and Apache 2.0 weights.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
